test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Urbanisation
P. disrupts tradition
Q. in heritage zones
R. and spatial congestion
S. through cultural dilution
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **PSRQ**

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 
 **__Key Points__**
 

 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Urbanisation," which is implied but not directly stated in the sequence.
 
• **Part (P):** "disrupts tradition" logically follows as the first action caused by urbanisation.
 
• **Part (S):** "through cultural dilution" adds further explanation about how the disruption occurs, making it the second logical part.
